title: Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI
shortDescription: Expand your empire, advance your culture and go head-to-head against history’s greatest leaders. Will your civilization stand the test of time?
zhShortDescription: 终极 4X 策略游戏，从石器时代到信息时代。
description: Civilization VI offers new ways to engage with your world: cities now physically expand across the map, active research in technology and culture unlocks new potential, and competing leaders will pursue their own agendas based on their historical traits as you race for one of five ways to achieve victory in the game. ‎‏‏‎‎‏‏‎ See the marvels of your empire spread across the map like never before. Each district, wonder, and improvement is built on its own hex, allowing you to customize your city to your heart’s content. From the Commercial Hub to the Spaceport, every district provides unique and powerful bonuses. Pick and choose which districts to build to fit your needs! Build better than your opponents, place yourself strategically for your allies, and become the best civilization on Eart
zhDescription: 《文明VI》是 Firaxis 打造的终极 4X 策略游戏。选择一位历史领袖，通过科技研发、文化发展、军事征服来赢得胜利。区域相邻加成系统是核心创新——每个区域的产出取决于周围地形。
metaDescriptionEn: Civilization VI review — the 4X strategy king. District adjacency, leader strategies, victory paths.
metaDescriptionZh: 《文明VI》Steam 评测与介绍 — 4X 策略游戏之王。区域相邻加成、领袖策略、胜利路线。

topReviews.review: Civilization VI is one of those games where you tell yourself you'll only play for an hour, and suddenly it’s 3 AM. Every civilization feels unique, fun to play, and no two playthroughs ever feel the same. The replayability is honestly insane, especially with the DLC. Definitely one of the most addicting strategy games I’ve played.
topReviews.zh_review: 《文明VI》就是那种你告诉自己只玩一小时，然后一抬头发现凌晨3点的游戏。每个文明都独特、好玩，没有两次体验是相同的。重玩性真的离谱，尤其加了DLC。绝对是我玩过最让人上瘾的策略游戏之一。

topReviews.review:
Personal Rating: Very Positive (90%)

I spent my entire morning and afternoon by playing this today.

I used to really hate the hexagonal tile design, as it looked really dumb to me. But after giving it one more shot today for... whatever reason, I actually really like it.

By gameplay, it's somewhere in between the old AoH2 and HoI4, and that's pretty much ideal. Pretty challenging, but not overcomplicated.

I can see myself playing further, as it's really enjoyable and time passes on really quickly when playing. But I don't know if I'll go for Civ 7 or any of the DLC's.
topReviews.zh_review: 个人评分：非常好评（90%）。今天玩了一整个上午和下午。我以前很讨厌六边形格子设计，觉得看起来很蠢。但今天不知为什么又给了一次机会……结果我真的很喜欢。游戏性介于老AoH2和HoI4之间，简直完美——有挑战但不复杂。时间过得飞快，真的好玩。不知道会不会入Civ 7或DLC。

whyPlay: Civilization VI is the 'one more turn' meme made flesh. Its district system adds genuine spatial planning to the 4X formula — where you place your campus matters as much as when you research it. Each leader plays distinctly enough that switching civs feels like learning a new game. If you've ever wanted to nuke Gandhi while listening to a full orchestra, this is your game.
whyPlayZh: 《文明VI》就是'再来一回合'这个梗的化身。它的区域系统给 4X 公式加入了真正的空间规划——学院区摆在哪和研究什么科技同样重要。每个领袖玩法差异足够大，换文明就像换游戏。如果你曾经想边听交响乐边核平甘地，这就是你要的游戏。
